<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 03b19d9cfdb7f0811dc27398b51b44d332a2ed88` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Nothing built, run or re-run; no worktree.

### ① Derived judgments

Net diff: three files, +9 / -2 — one `.describe()` string, its generated mirror, one changeset. Head repo is the base repo (not a fork). No governed-surface path in the file list. The file surface equals the claim's exactly; no objectui edit; the four branch commits net to exactly the PR's file list.

1. Accept set of `items` — UNCHANGED, right. `items: z.array(z.unknown()).optional()` is byte-identical before and after (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5209`); only the describe string moved. That is the claim's route and the file's VALUE posture (`:3285-3290`: the keys are the spec's, the value contract still lives in objectui; `mapping` at `:5223` holds the same way). No key, enum member, union arm, export or registration is added anywhere in the diff.
2. Public surface — UNCHANGED, right. No export added, removed or renamed; `api-surface/` untouched; a describe-only edit cannot move the compiled `.d.ts`.
3. Every clause of the new describe, read against the pin, not the dev's prose:
   - "objectui's declared timeline element" — TRUE. `packages/types/src/data-display.ts:2894` ("The element is declared: two arms, and `variant` picks one"); `items` is an array of `TimelineFeedItem` or `TimelineGanttItem` at `:2932`.
   - "`@object-ui/types`'s `TimelineFeedItem` … or `TimelineGanttItem`" — TRUE. Package name `@object-ui/types` (`packages/types/package.json`); both interfaces declared at `data-display.ts:2773` and `:2834`, exported from `packages/types/src/index.ts:261-262`.
   - feed arm = node `variant` absent / `vertical` / `horizontal`; gantt arm = `variant: 'gantt'` — TRUE. `data-display.ts:2899-2902`; the zod mirror's `TIMELINE_ITEM_ARMS` (`packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts:1201-1216`) and its refinement's "absent ⇒ vertical" (`:1219-1220`); objectui's own pin `timeline-item-element-6356.test.ts:161` ("absent reads as vertical").
   - "the arm this node's `variant` selects", for an `object-timeline` node — TRUE. `ObjectTimelineProps.schema` is `TimelineSchema` intersected with the object-bound keys (`packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx:165-219`), and the intersection redeclares neither `items` nor `variant`, so the node's element type and its three-value `variant` are `TimelineSchema`'s own. Authored `items` pass through untouched (`:546`, `:771`) into `effectiveSchema.items` (`:874`) and on to `TimelineRenderer` (`:942`), whose branch is chosen by `variant` (`renderer.tsx:1419` horizontal, `:1455` gantt, vertical otherwise) and reads only that arm's keys. `ObjectTimelinePropsSchema.variant` here is the same three values (`:5211`).
   - "the renderer becomes a pass-through" — TRUE: `:546` `if (schema.items) return schema.items;`. The retired sentence "the author owns the item shape" is gone from every carrier at the head (git grep over the whole tree: only the changeset quotes it, as the text being retired).
   - The round-1 refusal clause ("refuses a mismatched arm and undeclared keys") — GONE from the describe, from `component.mdx`, from the changeset and from the PR body's "What changed" paragraph; it survives only in the body's verification record as history, which is the right place. The removal is right, confirmed statically: `git grep object-timeline` over `packages/types/src/zod` at the pin returns nothing; the component union's `object-*` literals are grid / form / view / map / tree / gantt / calendar / kanban / chart / gallery / data-table, plus the sibling `timeline`. No runtime face judges an `object-timeline` node's items, so a refusal clause would have advertised enforcement that does not exist (Prime Directive #10). Round 1's clause was false; the dev measured it and removed it.
   - Non-blocking observation: `TimelineFeedItem` carries its own `variant` key, a marker colour (`TimelineItemVariant` = default / success / warning / danger / info, `data-display.ts:2751`, `:2785`). The parenthetical after `TimelineFeedItem` names the NODE's `variant` values, and the sentence's closing clause ("the arm this node's `variant` selects") is what fixes that reading; `TimelineGanttItem` has no `variant` key at all, so the gantt parenthetical admits no other reading. Not a false clause. A later edit that drops the closing clause would make it one.
4. No second vocabulary — right. The describe names two types by name and the node's own three `variant` values (already this schema's enum one line down); no key list (`time`, `title`, `label`, …) is copied. Consistent with triage 5859517446 and the claim's ⛔.
5. `component.mdx` is the generator's output — right. Row template `| **key** | type | required | desc |` (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/schema-section.ts:544`); `desc` is `escapeMdxDescription(description + externalVocabularyNote + dimensionlessNote)` then backslash and pipe escaping (`:536-543`). The new describe carries no brace, no angle bracket, no pipe, no backslash and no newline, and `items` declares neither `externalVocabulary` nor `dimensionless` (both notes read schema metadata, never prose), so the cell is the describe byte-for-byte — compared at the head: 383 bytes each, identical. The type cell `any[]` and the `optional` cell are unchanged because the shape is. Exactly one generated carrier exists (`json-schema/` is gitignored). CI's own answer, `check:docs` in `Type Check · source gates`: success on this head.
6. Docblock anchors — right. The `object-timeline` docblock's `items` read points (`:254`, `:374`, `:546`, `:771`) are byte-accurate at the pin; `:809` (`if (!hasAuthoredItems && schema.variant === 'gantt')`) still holds, so the neighbouring `variant` describe ("`gantt` needs authored `items`") stays true beside the new one. No anchor edit was needed and none was made.
7. Premise (no fork) — holds. `data-display.ts` at the pin imports only `ChartAxis` / `ChartType` / `I18nLabel` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`:18`); both timeline interfaces are declared locally, and nothing in this repo imports them.

- Skipped by design (2): `Console Pin Gate` (the `filter` job's console output is false — the diff touches neither the pin nor the console), `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`.

- Failures: none at the read, so nothing to attribute to this diff. Every derived family I could map to a workflow step has a check-run on this head; none is CI-less. One judgment has no CI family at all and is answered only here: the truth of the describe against the objectui pin — a prose claim about a sibling repo's types, which `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` (line anchors) does not read.
